name: nopool
note: DOES MORE DATA HELP, once dilution is removed? The prior scaling curve turned over past ~30 subjects on a UNION montage, where absent electrodes are zero-filled -- at the full cohort that is 136 electrodes at 32% occupancy, so two thirds of the input tensor is structural zero and the spatial mixer has to learn around a mask that changes per trial. That is a property of the pooling mechanism, not of subject count, and the objection that more data should not hurt is well founded. This sweep removes the mechanism: `channels` is pinned to the 9-electrode 10-20 subset (C3 C4 Cz F3 F4 Fz P3 P4 Pz) that all eight corpora physically record, so EVERY cohort below has 100% occupancy and ZERO structural zeros. Electrodes are fixed, trial length is fixed, recipe is fixed; only the number of people changes, 52 -> 354. If the curve now rises monotonically, the turnover was dilution and the union montage should be abandoned. If it still turns over, the cause is population/hardware heterogeneity and the fix is domain-level, not montage-level -- either way the answer is attributable, which the union-montage curve could never be.

arms.name: ours
arms.prediction: Monotone increase 52 -> 354 subjects, or at worst a plateau. The spatial mixer is 9 -> 36 and every one of its inputs carries real signal in every trial, so the mechanism blamed for the previous turnover is absent by construction. A turnover here would be a genuinely different finding and would point at population heterogeneity.

arms.name: eegnet
arms.prediction: Same shape as `ours`. This is the control that decides attribution: if BOTH architectures turn over on identical data, the cause is the cohort; if only one does, it is the architecture. Running the arm without its control is the error this project has already made and corrected twice.

arms.name: ours_noalign
arms.prediction: Lower throughout, and turning over sooner. Alignment was measured to roughly halve the giveback on the union curve; with dilution removed, whatever gap remains between this and `ours` is what alignment is actually buying against population heterogeneity alone.
